df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='JUNpaMa'].copy()
# per resource: cost on 10/16 vs mean of other days, and contribution
res = sub.groupby('instance_family').apply(
    lambda g: pd.Series({
        'mean': g[g['date']!='10/16/25']['unblended_cost'].mean(),
        'std': g[g['date']!='10/16/25']['unblended_cost'].std(),
        'c16': g[g['date']=='10/16/25']['unblended_cost'].sum()
    }), include_groups=False)
res['diff'] = res['c16'] - res['mean']
res['z'] = (res['c16']-res['mean'])/res['std']
print("Total diff:", res['diff'].sum())
# top contributors to deviation
print(res.sort_values('diff', key=abs, ascending=False).head(12))"}
